discarded.reason: the segment's first frame implies it was captured 95443.6s ago, which is before the publisher started 12.0s ago, which cannot happen. The wall-clock timestamps the publisher wrote did not survive the pipeline, most likely because the media engine rebased the stream to start at zero when it repackaged. Latency cannot be measured this way against this deployment; the per-hop split from the uploader log still can.
